manifest.title: Instatic
manifest.author: Dustin Dauncey <dustin@d19.ca>
manifest.tagline: Visual CMS that publishes fast, plain HTML
manifest.description:
# Instatic

Instatic is an open-source visual CMS that publishes semantic, plain HTML and clean CSS. The public site is served from generated static artifacts, while authors manage content and design through the protected `/admin` interface.

This Cloudron Community App package provides managed PostgreSQL, persistent media and published artifacts, automatic encryption-secret generation, Cloudron outbound email for form notifications, health monitoring, backups, restore compatibility, and restart-safe configuration.

Instatic is an early-stage upstream project. Review the package changelog and take a backup before every update.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
Instatic is ready at **$CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN**.

1. Open **$CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN/admin**.
2. Complete Instatic's first-run setup and create the owner account. No default credentials are generated.
3. Publish a page and verify it anonymously.
4. Form notifications default to the Cloudron sender address. To send them elsewhere, create `/app/data/env` with `INSTATIC_FORM_EMAIL_TO='recipient@example.com'`, then restart the app.

The admin area uses Instatic's own accounts, sessions, CSRF protection, login rate limiting, step-up authentication, and optional TOTP MFA. Cloudron dashboard visibility does not grant an Instatic account.
manifest.changelog:
* Lower the default Cloudron memory limit from 1 GiB to 512 MiB based on upstream deployment sizing and constrained runtime testing.
* Improve dependency-layer reuse across upstream source changes with content-addressed manifest/vendor stages while remaining compatible with Cloudron's non-BuildKit on-server builder.
* Assign final runtime ownership during COPY to avoid duplicating the application tree in a recursive chown layer.
* Exclude upstream test sources from the production runtime image after the build-stage test suite completes.
